description: SEC Form D private offerings — Private fundraising (Reg D) from SEC EDGAR Form D filings. No params = the latest Form D filings, parsed: issuer, state, industry or fund type, exemption (506(b)/506(c)/3(c)), total offering, amount sold, remaining, investors so far, first sale date, securities (equity/debt/SAFE...), executives and directors, signals. Filters: industry= (e.g. technology, biotech, real estate, venture capital), state=CA, funds=include|exclude|only, min_amount=1000000, amendments=false, limit=1-25. Or cik= / company= for one issuer Form D history (limit=1-10). Public domain. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
